name: llm-first-loop
title_zh: 22 个技能打包卖，每个都先问你要什么再动手
tagline_zh: 不是技能合集，是 22 个会先反问你的小工具。装一个包，得到 22 次「先想清楚再干活」的提醒，每个都自带使用边界。
tagline_en: Not a bundle—22 tools that question you first. One install, 22 reminders to define goals before acting, each with.
why_zh: 每个技能都内置「先问后做」机制，逼你输入前先定义目标。打包卖不是堆数量。
why_en: Every skill has a 'ask-first' mechanism, forcing you to define goals before input. Bundling isn't stacking—it's 22 varied.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 22 个预设场景，超出范围它不会硬做，而是停下来问你。需要你自己先想清楚要什么，它不替你决策。装完要逐个试。
limit_en: Covers only 22 preset scenarios; beyond that it stops and asks. You must define intent yourself—it won't decide for you. Try each after install; not.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 22 skills, each asks what you want before acting
